title: San Francisco 49ers vs. Seattle Seahawks Postgame Analysis: What Happened, What We Got Right and What We Learned
seo_title: San Francisco 49ers 32-29 Seattle Seahawks: EdgeDesk Postgame Thesis Audit
excerpt: San Francisco 49ers won 32-29. The number did not land and the reasoning did not either. This is the case that should change something, and the lessons below say what.
seo_description: San Francisco 49ers beat Seattle Seahawks 32-29. EdgeDesk’s number implied Seattle Seahawks -3 — loss. 0 of 11 gradeable claims held up, 8 did not. Process grade: UNSOUND. Research, not picks.
model_status_note: The number did not land and the reasoning did not either. This is the case that should change something, and the lessons below say what.
author: EdgeDesk Research
research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 65 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.
market_source: The sportsbook number on this page is a quote EdgeDesk captured at Pinnacle and theScore Bet on 2026-10-06, replayed from a committed snapshot rather than read live. It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.
